title: rclone move ignore-existing does not ignore removing
body:
#### The associated forum post URL from `https://forum.rclone.org`
https://forum.rclone.org/t/move-moveto-ignore-existing-delete-src-even-if-src-dst/11759

#### What is the problem you are having with rclone?
`move/moveto --ignore-existing` a file which exists in both source and destination folder, the destination file is left untouched, but the source file is deleted.


#### What is your rclone version (output from `rclone version`)
1.55.1

#### Which OS you are using and how many bits (e.g. Windows 7, 64 bit)
Ubuntu 20.04


#### Which cloud storage system are you using? (e.g. Google Drive)
Google Drive / Local


#### The command you were trying to run (e.g. `rclone copy /tmp remote:tmp`)
Test script (a file named both exists in both src and dst folder):
```sh
mkdir dsrc ddst                                                                                                                                                                               
echo src > dsrc/only-in-src                                                                                                                                                                   
echo dst > ddst/only-in-dst                                                                                                                                                                   
echo src > dsrc/in-both                                                                                                                                                                       
echo dst > ddst/in-both                                                                                                                                                                       
head dsrc/* ddst/*                                                                                                                                                                            
rclone move dsrc ddst --ignore-existing -vv                                                                                                                                                   
head dsrc/* ddst/*               
```

rclone move --ignore-existing src
rclone moveto --ignore-existing dst

#### A log from the command with the `-vv` flag (e.g. output from `rclone -vv copy /tmp remote:tmp`)
rclone move dsrc ddst --ignore-existing -vv
```
DEBUG : rclone: Version "v1.55.1" starting with parameters ["rclone" "move" "dsrc" "ddst" "--ignore-existing" "-vv"]
DEBUG : Creating backend with remote "dsrc"
DEBUG : fs cache: renaming cache item "dsrc" to be canonical "/dev/shm/dsrc"
DEBUG : Creating backend with remote "ddst"
DEBUG : fs cache: renaming cache item "ddst" to be canonical "/dev/shm/ddst"
DEBUG : Local file system at /dev/shm/ddst: Using server-side directory move
INFO  : Local file system at /dev/shm/ddst: Server side directory move failed - fallback to file moves: can't copy directory - destination already exists
DEBUG : Local file system at /dev/shm/ddst: Waiting for checks to finish
INFO  : only-in-src: Moved (server-side)
======BUG vvv=======
DEBUG : in-both: Destination exists, skipping
INFO  : in-both: Deleted
======BUG ^^^=======
DEBUG : Local file system at /dev/shm/ddst: Waiting for transfers to finish
INFO  : There was nothing to transfer
```

When a file exists in both src and dst, the MOVE phase is skipped, but the DELETE phase is not.
In such case, the data src/in-both is missing.
